1.consolidated_definition: Pez marino de cuerpo alargado, que alcanza hasta 40 cm de longitud, de color gris perla, por lo general con rayas amarillas oblicuas y reflejos azulados; su carne es muy apreciada. Haemulidae, Haemulon spp.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Marine fish with an elongated body, reaching up to 40 cm in length, of a grey pearl color, generally featuring oblique yellow stripes and blue reflections; its flesh is highly prized. Haemulidae, Haemulon spp.
